description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion upon the target hit.
- When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, press Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.
- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a Solo Concert. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or Solo Concert ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an Ensemble Sylph is generated.

Solo Concert

When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

Ensemble Sylph

Up to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.
If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter Solo Concert.
If Ciaccona's Solo Concert is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will continue the Solo Concert for Ciaccona.
Aside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by Resonance Skill will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering Solo Concert.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

Aimed Attack

Press Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing Aero DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

Dodge Counter

Follow up successful Dodges with Basic Attack to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan Aero DMG. Basic Attack Tahap 4 menimpakan 1 stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena.
- Saat tiga tahap pertama Basic Attack Ciaccona diinterupsi oleh dodge, tekan Basic Attack tepat waktu untuk melanjutkan siklus serangan dan melancarkan tahap Basic Attack yang sesuai.
- Setelah Basic Attack Tahap 4, Ciaccona memulai Solo Concert. Jika Basic Attack Tahap 4 Ciaccona atau Solo Concert berakhir lebih awal (secara sengaja atau terinterupsi), Ensemble Sylph dihasilkan.

Solo Concert

Saat Ciaccona atau Ensemble Sylph melakukan Solo Concert, mereka memberi 24% Aero DMG Bonus kepada semua Resonator di tim yang berada di dekat. Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.

Ensemble Sylph

Hingga 2 Ensemble Sylph dapat ada bersamaan.
Jika Basic Attack Tahap 4 Ciaccona diinterupsi, Ensemble Sylph yang dihasilkan akan menyelesaikan serangan untuk Ciaccona dan memasuki Solo Concert.
Jika Solo Concert Ciaccona diinterupsi, Ensemble Sylph yang dihasilkan akan melanjutkan Solo Concert untuk Ciaccona.
Selain dua situasi di atas, Ensemble Sylph yang dihasilkan oleh Resonance Skill akan menyelesaikan serangan Ciaccona saat ini tanpa memasuki Solo Concert.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melompat ke udara dan menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

Aimed Attack

Tekan Aim untuk memasuki Aiming Mode dan menembakkan tembakan isi, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun, memberikan Aero DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack setelah Mid-air Attack Tahap 2 untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 4.

Dodge Counter

Lanjutkan Dodge yang berhasil dengan Basic Attack untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Move a certain distance, dealing Aero DMG and inflicting 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target upon hit.
Press Normal Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
- When Ciaccona interrupts Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, or Solo Concert with Resonance Skill, an Ensemble Sylph is generated.
- Ciaccona's Resonance Skill can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Bergerak sejauh jarak tertentu, memberikan Aero DMG dan menimpakan 1 stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena.
Tekan Normal Attack tepat waktu untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
- Saat Ciaccona menginterupsi Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, atau Solo Concert dengan Resonance Skill, Ensemble Sylph dihasilkan.
- Resonance Skill Ciaccona dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en:
Ciaccona and Ensemble Sylphs perform an Improvised Symphonic Poem together, dealing Aero DMG once to the nearby targets and entering Recital.

Recital

When in Recital, sound waves will periodically radiate around Ciaccona. When the sound wave overlaps with the circle indicator, press the green or yellow buttons to generate Symphonic Poem: Tonic of the corresponding color and recover a certain amount of Concerto Energy.
During Recital:
- Switching to another Resonator doesn't end Recital, but automatically generates a Symphonic Poem: Tonic matching the color of the last generated Tonic before switching. A green Symphonic Poem: Tonic is generated by default if no interaction input is given before switching to another Resonator.
- Ciaccona is immune to interruptions and takes 50% less DMG.
- Exit Recital by pressing Resonance Liberation again or switching Ciaccona back onto the field.
- Ensemble Sylphs can now directly grant Aero DMG Bonus provided by Solo Concert.

Symphonic Poem: Tonic

Green Tonic: Deal Aero DMG to nearby targets and inflict a stack of Aero Erosion on targets hit.
Yellow Tonic: Deal Aero DMG to nearby targets and inflict a stack of Spectro Frazzle on targets hit.
description.id:
Ciaccona dan Ensemble Sylph bersama-sama membawakan Improvised Symphonic Poem, memberikan Aero DMG satu kali ke target di sekitar dan memasuki Recital.

Recital

Saat dalam Recital, gelombang suara akan memancar secara berkala di sekitar Ciaccona. Saat gelombang suara bertumpang tindih dengan indikator lingkaran, tekan tombol hijau atau kuning untuk menghasilkan Symphonic Poem: Tonic dengan warna yang sesuai dan memulihkan sejumlah Concerto Energy.
Selama Recital:
- Berganti ke Resonator lain tidak mengakhiri Recital, tetapi otomatis menghasilkan Symphonic Poem: Tonic dengan warna yang sama dengan Tonic terakhir yang dihasilkan sebelum berganti. Symphonic Poem: Tonic hijau dihasilkan secara default jika tidak ada input interaksi sebelum berganti ke Resonator lain.
- Ciaccona kebal terhadap interupsi dan menerima 50% lebih sedikit DMG.
- Keluar dari Recital dengan menekan Resonance Liberation lagi atau mengganti Ciaccona kembali ke lapangan.
- Ensemble Sylph kini dapat langsung memberikan Aero DMG Bonus dari Solo Concert.

Symphonic Poem: Tonic

Tonic Hijau: Memberikan Aero DMG ke target di sekitar dan menimpakan satu stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena.
Tonic Kuning: Memberikan Aero DMG ke target di sekitar dan menimpakan satu stack Spectro Frazzle pada target yang terkena.

description.en: Casting Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza grants Ciaccona a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. Switching out Ciaccona removes the Shield.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza memberi Ciaccona Shield sebesar 100% Max HP-nya selama 4 dtk. Mengganti Ciaccona keluar menghapus Shield.

description.en: Increase Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat's DMG by 30%.
description.id: Meningkatkan DMG Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat sebesar 30%.

description.en:
Attack the target to deal Aero DMG and inflict a stack of Aero Erosion.
Follow up with Basic Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
description.id:
Menyerang target untuk memberikan Aero DMG dan menimpakan satu stack Aero Erosion.
Lanjutkan dengan Basic Attack tepat waktu untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

description.en:
Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat

When there are 3 segments of Musical Essence, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat.
Consume all Musical Essence to shoot Downbeat Notes forward to deal Aero DMG, pulling in the nearby targets and inflicting 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target hit.
Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Musical Essence

Ciaccona can hold up to 3 segments of Musical Essence.
Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 or Intro Skill recovers 1 segment of Musical Essence.
description.id:
Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat

Saat ada 3 segmen Musical Essence, Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat.
Mengonsumsi seluruh Musical Essence untuk menembakkan Downbeat Notes ke depan untuk memberikan Aero DMG, menarik target di sekitar dan menimpakan 1 stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena.
Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

Musical Essence

Ciaccona dapat menyimpan hingga 3 segmen Musical Essence.
Melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 4 atau Intro Skill memulihkan 1 segmen Musical Essence.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Memiliki peluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Aero Erosion DMG dealt to targets near the active Resonator is Amplified by 100% for 30s.
description.id: Aero Erosion DMG yang diberikan ke target di dekat Resonator aktif mendapat Amplify sebesar 100% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill Harmonic Allegro grants Ciaccona immunity to interruption for 3s. Casting Basic Attack increases Ciaccona's ATK by 35% for 10s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill Harmonic Allegro memberi Ciaccona kekebalan terhadap interupsi selama 3 dtk. Melancarkan Basic Attack meningkatkan ATK Ciaccona sebesar 35% selama 10 dtk.

description.en: During Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza, Resonators in the team gain 40% Aero DMG Bonus.
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza, Resonator di tim mendapat 40% Aero DMG Bonus.

description.en: Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 additionally grants 1 segments of Musical Essence. Resonance Skill Harmonic Allegro gains 1 more charge.
description.id: Melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 4 juga memberikan 1 segmen Musical Essence. Resonance Skill Harmonic Allegro mendapat 1 charge tambahan.

description.en:
Ciaccona ignores 45% of the targets' DEF when dealing damage with Heavy Attack Quadruple Downbeat;
Ciaccona ignores 45% of the targets' DEF when dealing Resonance Liberation DMG.
description.id:
Ciaccona mengabaikan 45% DEF target saat memberikan damage dengan Heavy Attack Quadruple Downbeat;
Ciaccona mengabaikan 45% DEF target saat memberikan Resonance Liberation DMG.

description.en:
Gain 40% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus;
DMG taken by Resonators within and around the range of Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza is reduced by 30%.
description.id:
Mendapat 40% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus;
DMG yang diterima Resonator di dalam dan di sekitar jangkauan Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza berkurang 30%.

description.en: When in Solo Concert, Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph deals Aero DMG equal to 220% of Ciaccona's ATK to nearby targets, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
description.id: Saat dalam Solo Concert, Ciaccona atau Ensemble Sylph memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 220% ATK Ciaccona ke target di sekitar, dianggap Resonance Liberation DMG.
